working_tree: plus the pinned SVM signer/recipient in zk-verdict/script/src/bin/svm.rs, which lands in the commit that carries this file
note: Measured with `cargo run --release --bin <guest> -- --execute` in zk-verdict/script, after 008 parts 1-3 changed all three guests. SP1 execution is deterministic for a fixed ELF and a fixed input; the SVM harness used to build a random Keypair per run, so its count varied (1,003,195 / 993,018 / 984,496 / 983,746 / 987,632 over five runs of one ELF). The signer and recipient are pinned now, and three consecutive runs give 986,097.
